content: Multi-currency NW best practice: store balances in native currency; convert only at report time using rate effective for the report as-of date (carry-forward dated rates). Never reproject entire history with today's FX (rewrites history). Ghostfolio ExchangeRateDataService.toCurrencyAtDate looks up MarketData by date; missing rates break charts. Mozaic/PortfolioPilot: freeze or time-stamp conversion per history point. For snapshot apps: NW(D)=sum(native_balance_asof(D)*fx_asof(D))-credit_debts.
